html:
The Tibian Explorer Society is an elite society of adventurers that explore and research all aspects of Tibia. They are interested in the many different races of creatures, as well as the history of curious structures and items.

The society positions itself where it can be easily accessed by members, but far from the greater metropolis cities. It has outposts in five locations: Port Hope, Northport, Liberty Bay, Svargrond and Yalahar.

To become a member of the Tibian Explorer Society, each person must prove their worth and dedication to the discovery of facts and gaining of knowledge, as well as a brave explorer's spirit. Visit the outposts in Port Hope or Northport if you are interested in joining!

Main base of The Explorer Society Quest.
